clutch and the coefficient of friction does not change, then the ratio [latex]F_1/F_2[/latex] is_________

questions.subject: Mechanical Engineering
questions.text:
Two business owners Shveta and Ashok run their businesses in two different states. Each
of them, independent of the other, produces two products A and B, sells them at Rs.
2,000 per kg and Rs, 3,000 per kg, respectively, and uses Linear Programming to
determine the optimal quantity of A and B to maximize their respective daily revenue.
Their constraints are as follows: i) for each business owner, the production process is
such that the daily production of A has to be at least as much as B, and the upper
limit for production of B is 10 kg per day, and ii) the respective state regulations restrict
Shveta?s production of A to less than 20 kg per day and Ashok's production of A to
less than 15 kg per day. The demand of both A and B in both the states is very high
and everything produced is sold. The absolute value of the difference in daily (optimal) revenue of Shveta and Ashok is
________ thousand Rupees (round off to 2 decimal places)

Consider two cases as below. Case 1: A company buys 1000 pieces per year of a certain part from vendor 'X'. The
changeover time is 2 hours and the price is Rs. 10 per piece. The holding cost rate
per part is 10% per year. Case 2: For the same part, another vendor 'Y' offers a design where the changeover
time is 6 minutes, with a price of Rs. 5 per piece, and a holding cost rate per part of
100% per year. The order size is 800 pieces per year from 'X' and 200 pieces per year
from 'Y'. Assume the cost of downtime as Rs. 200 per hour. The percentage reduction in the annual
cost for Case 2, as compared to Case 1 is___________ (round off to 2 decimal places).

compressor is 85 percent, the difference in enthalpies of air between the exit and the
inlet of the compressor is ________ kJ/kg (round off to nearest integer).

questions.text:
Water flows through a tube of 3 cm internal diameter and length 20 m, The outside surface
of the tube is heated electrically so that it is subjected to uniform heat flux circumferentially
and axially. The mean inlet and exit temperatures of the water are [latex]10^{\circ}C \; and \; 70^{\circ}C[/latex],
respectively. The mass flow rate of the water is 720 kg/h. Disregard the thermal resistance
of the tube wall. The internal heat transfer coefficient is 1697 [latex]W/m^2\cdot K[/latex]. Take specific heat
[latex]C_p[/latex] of water as 4.179 kJ/kg.K. The inner surface temperature at the exit section of the
tube is __________ [latex]^{\circ}C[/latex] (round off to one decimal place).

questions.subject: Mechanical Engineering
questions.text:
Moist air at 105 kPa, 30[latex]^{\circ}C[/latex] and 80% relative humidity flows over a cooling coil in an
insulated air-conditioning duct. Saturated air exits the duct at 100 kPa and 15[latex]^{\circ}C[/latex]. The
saturation pressure of water at 30[latex]^{\circ}C[/latex] and 15[latex]^{\circ}C[/latex] are 4.24 kPa and 1.7 kPa respectively.
Molecular weight of water is 18 g/mol and that of air is 28.94 g/mol. The mass of water
condensing out from the duct is ______ g/kg of dry air (round off to 2 decimal places).

questions.subject: Mechanical Engineering
questions.text:
Keeping all other parameters identical, the Compression Ratio (CR) of an air standard
diesel cycle is increased from 15 to 21. Take ratio of specific heats = 1.3 and cut-off
ratio of the cycle [latex]r_c = 2[/latex]. The difference between the new and the old efficiency values, in percentage, [latex](\eta _{new}|_{ CR = 21})-(\eta _{old}|_{CR = 15})=[/latex] _______ %. (round off to one decimal place)
